property_summary: For any caller and any amount, sending 10 ether to C's fallback succeeds (does not revert) on the reference contract; the mutant changes the value check so some calls that send 10 ether will revert, which the fuzzer can find by varying caller and amount (and timestamp/block).
change_summary: Change the require on msg.value from == 10 ether to != 10 ether, so calls with 10 ether now revert while others proceed.
